title: A regular unit times a parameter-power quotient has nonnegative exponent
statement: Let F be a field, W a subring of F, and s ∈ F satisfy s ∈ W and s⁻¹ ∉ W. Let u be a unit of W, with image ū in F, and let r,k be natural numbers. If ū s^r/s^k belongs to W, then k ≤ r.
lean_statement: ∀ (F : Type*) [Field F] (W : Subring F) (s : F), s ∈ W → s⁻¹ ∉ W → ∀ (u : Units W) (r k : ℕ), ((u : W) : F) * s ^ r / s ^ k ∈ W → k ≤ r
